_README: Verified inventory of GRI disclosures used as the TARGET vocabulary for the
STARS -> GRI mapping. Nothing in this file was written from model memory:
every standard below was retrieved from globalreporting.org on 2026-08-14
and, for the environmental standards, cross-checked against two independent
validate_mapping.py checks every gri_disclosure in the mapping table against
this file. A disclosure number that does not appear here is a hard error --
that is the mechanism that makes an invented GRI reference impossible to ship.
Attribution: GRI Standards are published by the Global Reporting Initiative.
Cite as: GRI <n>: <title>. Global Reporting Initiative. Retrieved <date> from <url>.

corroboration.primary: globalreporting.org publication pages (full standard text) + official PDFs in standards/gri/
